$comment: The permission boundary, ported from colleague's containment guards (issue #1). Origins: colleague/colleague/search_tools.py (confine, _refuse_pattern_escape, DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS=200), colleague/colleague/readpage.py (1000 lines / 25,000 chars), colleague/colleague/web.py (_MAX_RAW_CHARS=2,000,000). Adapters read these values; they must not hardcode their own copy.

read_only.$comment: The read-only subset of the allowlist (plan t12, risk r9). The allowlist above is a PERMISSION list and holds commands that write (eidetic remember, ledger append); this list is the CLASSIFICATION the tool_call guard uses for the safety gate's isMutating. A bash call skips the gate only when the allowlist accepts its argv AND it matches an entry here (argv[1] in the entry's subcommands when it names any) AND it carries none of the entry's unsafe_options (a token naming the option, with or without =value, or any abbreviation of it, since git accepts unambiguous long-option prefixes) or unsafe_short_flags (a letter inside a single-dash flag cluster). Everything else is mutating and gated. The unsafe options are the ones that make a reading command run a program or write a file.

spawn.$comment: spawn_subagent (plan t16): max_output_chars bounds the child's hand-back plus final text returned to the parent; timeout_ms is one child's wall clock, after which its process group is killed; spawn_subagent caps it further at what is left of the parent run (ASSOCIATE_RUN_DEADLINE, set by the Python harness from its --timeout) minus a safety margin, so a child never outlives its parent.

delegate.$comment: delegate_run / delegate_status (deviation d18): timeout_ms is passed to the delegated `associate run` as its --timeout (the wait for the delegated model's pi run; worktree setup and the operator's test commands come on top, each command under associate run's own --test-timeout). 1,800,000 ms (30 min) because live worker runs on this repo have taken up to ~25 minutes; the resident's turn is not held for it, since delegate_run returns at once. max_output_chars bounds what delegate_status returns of the delegated run's result (its final reply first).

redaction.$comment: Applied harness-side to every walk/statements artifact before it is written — a filter, never an instruction to the model.
